The ImplementationGuide is based on FHIR version 5.0.0 but package ans.fr.terminologies#1.14.0 is based on FHIR version 4.0.1. In general, this version mismatch should be avoided - some tools will try to make this work with variable degrees of success, but others will not even try
The URL should refer directly to the ImplementationGuide resource (e.g. include '/ImplementationGuide/')
The canonical URL https://ansforge.github.io/interop-IG-cda-document-core/main/ig/package.tgz doesn't point to an actual ImplementationGuide resource

The packageId ans.cda.fr.document-core points to the canonical https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/cda/document-core which is inconsistent with the stated canonical of https://ansforge.github.io/interop-IG-cda-document-core/main/ig/package.tgz

The resource ImplementationGuide/ans.cda.fr.fr-eprescription could usefully have an OID assigned (OIDs are easy to assign - see https://build.fhir.org/ig/FHIR/fhir-tools-ig/CodeSystem-ig-parameters.html#ig-parameters-auto-oid-root)

The slice definition for ClinicalDocument.component.structuredBody.component:sectionPrescriptionMedicaments.section.entry.substanceAdministration.author has a maximum of 1 but the slices add up to a maximum of 2. Check that this is what is intended
